ios.desc:
Letler is a daily word puzzle game that challenges your vocabulary and deduction skills.

Every day, you get a fresh word to crack. Make your guesses, and watch as the game gives you alphabetical hints to guide you toward the answer.
If you’re stuck, no worries. A quick hint reveals the final letter to help you out. 

The challenge? 
Solve it with as few guesses as you can. And when you do, share your success and show off your word-solving skills. 
Letler turns wordplay into an addictive daily ritual, making every day a new challenge to conquer!
